name: afk
description: A help router plus an optional ship orchestrator for the AFK flow: prototype (throwaway logic/UI exploration) → grill (relentless plan interview, docs-aware) → implement (lead plans, workers run bounded TDD slices) → simplify (parallel cleanup) → qa (frontend/backend evidence verification). Ships a persistent brain/ memory vault (reflect, ruminate, meditate, plan, review, brain) that the flow reads before acting and writes back to as it learns.
